subject: ⚠️ Attendance Flag — $classroom_name
body:
Hi $participant_name,

This is an automated note to flag that your attendance in $classroom_name has dropped below the threshold we monitor. We are not in a position to take action on the basis of this email alone, but we wanted you to know early so you can do something about it before it becomes a bigger problem.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
ATTENDANCE SUMMARY
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Classroom:           $classroom_name
Module Code:         $module_code
Reporting Window:    $window_start to $window_end
Sessions Held:       $sessions_held
Sessions Attended:   $sessions_attended
Attendance Rate:     $attendance_rate%
Threshold:           $threshold%
Recent Misses:       $recent_misses

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

WHAT YOU CAN DO

  • Catch up on missed sessions via the recordings linked on the module page.
  • If circumstances are making attendance hard, talk to your personal tutor — extensions, mitigating circumstances, or a phased catch-up plan can often be arranged.
  • If the flag is wrong (sessions you actually attended), reply and we'll fix it; auto-counts occasionally miss late joins.

WHY THIS MATTERS

  • Engagement is a condition of progression and, for international students, of visa compliance.
  • Persistent low attendance can trigger a wellbeing referral or a formal academic-engagement review.

We'd rather hear from you about a problem now than chase you about a failed module later. Take care.

Kind regards,
Virtual Classroom Team
